lines.text: Half back to the terraces. Half to the school. The kids will name it. God help us.
The school. You saw it. A slate, a bench, six kids. It is not licensed.

choice.text: I will not report it. The Reaches need more of these.
Share the bed with the families and the yard, evenly.

lines.text: ...Fine. Fine. Do not make it weird.
Even shares. The crew will argue about the evens for a year.
